ops.text: Beyond WASP-12 b, transit-timing searches for orbital decay have so far produced at most tentative detections [e.g., Fuenzalida et al., 2026].

new_bib.text: T. Fuenzalida, C. Riquelme, I. Arancibia, V. Henríquez, B. Toledo, and J. Contreras (2026). Sixteen years of transit timing of the massive hot Jupiter TOI-8317 b: evidence for tidal orbital decay around a main-sequence G dwarf. AJ, submitted.
